maintenanceReports.title: 5G NR Sector 1 eCPRI Optical Link Remediation Report
maintenanceReports.summary: Replaced degraded 25G SFP28 transceiver on BBU6648 port CPRI-1A, cleaned duplex LC patch bulkhead, and verified optical budget (-6.4 dBm Rx).
maintenanceReports.purposeOfVisit: Emergency tower climb and CPRI optical restoration on Sector-2 Nokia AirScale RRH.
maintenanceReports.serviceImpactSummary: Sector-2 4G LTE / 5G NR cell outage (approx. 1,450 active UE sessions shifted to neighboring sectors during fault window).
maintenanceReports.mainFindings: Cracked weatherproofing boot on RRH OPT1 allowed moisture ingress onto 9.8G SFP+ transceiver pins, dropping Rx power to -31.8 dBm.
maintenanceReports.finalOutcome: SFP+ transceiver and cold-shrink boot replaced; optical Rx restored to -5.4 dBm; Sector-2 cell traffic verified nominal.
maintenanceReports.diagnosticProcedures:
1. Optical power measurement at BBU and RRH using EXFO FPM-300.
2. IEC 61300-3-35 fiber end-face scope inspection.

checklistTemplates.name: RAN, BBU, RRU & Antenna Line Inspection
checklistTemplates.description: Standard field inspection checklist for 2G/3G/4G/5G BBU subracks, RRH/AAU optical/RF ports, VSWR return loss sweeps, and AISG RET actuators.

items.label: Measure Sector RF Feeder / Jumper Return Loss & VSWR (Site Master)
items.expectedStandard: VSWR <= 1.4:1 across operating band

items.label: Verify CPRI / eCPRI SFP+ Optical Rx/Tx Power Levels at BBU & RRU
items.expectedStandard: Rx between -3.0 dBm and -11.5 dBm

items.label: Inspect 4.3-10 / DIN 7/16 RF Connector Torque & Cold-Shrink Weatherproofing
items.expectedStandard: No moisture ingress; torqued to 5 Nm (4.3-10)

items.label: Verify AISG RS-485 RET Actuator Bus Continuity & Electrical Tilt Calibration
items.expectedStandard: RET online in NMS; tilt matches RF design sheet

items.label: Verify RRU Protective Earth Bonding to Tower Busbar
items.expectedStandard: Ground lug tight, < 0.2 Ohm continuity

checklistTemplates.name: Microwave & Backhaul Transmission Alignment Checklist
checklistTemplates.description: Checklist for split-mount and all-outdoor microwave links (IDU/ODU, IF cable, waveguide pressure, RSL/XPD, and ACM modulation stability).

items.label: Record Received Signal Level (RSL) at Local & Far-End ODU
items.expectedStandard: Within +/- 2.0 dB of link budget target (-36.5 dBm)

items.label: Verify Cross-Polarization Discrimination (XPD) & ACM Modulation Lock
items.expectedStandard: XPD > 28 dB; locked at 256QAM / 512QAM in clear sky

items.label: Inspect Dish Pan/Tilt Struts, Ice Shield & Azimuth Lockbolts
items.expectedStandard: Zero play on fine-adjust threads; anti-seize applied

items.label: Check Coaxial IF Cable / Ethernet PoE Surge Arrestor & Grounding Kit
items.expectedStandard: Weatherproofed at top, midpoint, and shelter entry

checklistTemplates.name: AC/DC Power Plant, Rectifier, Battery Bank & Diesel Generator Checklist
checklistTemplates.description: Electromechanical and DC plant preventive/corrective checklist covering ATS transfer, rectifier load sharing, LLVD/BLVD thresholds, and VRLA/LiFePO4 health.

items.label: Measure -48V DC Bus Float Voltage & Rectifier Module Load Sharing
items.expectedStandard: -53.5V to -54.2V DC float; < 5% current imbalance

items.label: Verify LLVD (43.2V) & BLVD (45.0V) Contactor Thresholds in Controller
items.expectedStandard: Smartpack2 / NetSure thresholds match carrier standard

items.label: Test Standby Diesel Generator Auto-Start & ATS Load Transfer
items.expectedStandard: Starts within 12s; 400VAC / 50Hz or 208VAC / 60Hz stable

items.label: Inspect Fuel Tank Level, Crank Battery (24V), Oil Pressure & Coolant Heater
items.expectedStandard: Fuel > 65%; crank battery > 25.4V float

items.label: Measure Battery String Internal Conductance / BMS Cell Balance
items.expectedStandard: Zero swollen monoblocks; BMS SOH >= 85%

checklistTemplates.name: Fiber-Optic ODF, DWDM & Outside Plant Splice Verification
checklistTemplates.description: Optical inspection checklist for ODF patch panels, SFP28/QSFP28 transceivers, OTDR trace loss, and FDT/Manhole splice enclosures.

items.label: Inspect & Clean LC/UPC or SC/APC Connector End-Faces with Digital Scope
items.expectedStandard: IEC 61300-3-35 Pass (zero core or cladding contamination)

items.label: Measure Optical Tx/Rx Power & Span Attenuation with Optical Power Meter
items.expectedStandard: Span loss < 0.25 dB/km @ 1550nm + 0.3 dB per mated pair

items.label: Verify Minimum Bend Radius (> 30mm) & Patch Cord Labeling in ODF
items.expectedStandard: No macro-bends; TIA-606 compliant labels on both ends

checklistTemplates.name: Environmental, HVAC, Grounding & External Dry-Contact Alarms
checklistTemplates.description: Checklist for shelter HVAC/free-cooling blowers, door intrusion sensors, smoke/fire relays, Class I/II SPD arrestors, and earth pit resistance.

items.label: Measure Shelter / Cabinet Internal Ambient Temperature & Humidity
items.expectedStandard: Temperature +18°C to +30°C; RH < 65%

items.label: Measure Main Earth Ground Bar & Pit Resistance (Clamp Tester)
items.expectedStandard: Earth resistance < 5.0 Ohms (< 2.0 Ohms for Core/BSC)

items.label: Test Door Intrusion, High-Temp, Smoke & SPD Dry-Contact Loops to NOC
items.expectedStandard: All DI relays verified end-to-end with NOC operator

items.label: Inspect HVAC Intake Filters, Damper Actuators & 48V Emergency Blowers
items.expectedStandard: Filters clean; emergency DC fan engages at +32°C
